summary: Vote for Peace rated Tomara Hall an Ally in the 2026 general election for Trustee Area 2 of the San José Unified School District board, an assessment the organization bases on human rights and AIPAC funding evaluations. Samir Laymoun, an activist opinion source, also supported her candidacy. Under this guide, the Vote for Peace Ally designation constitutes concrete stance evidence.
